brief:
Newly updated satellite imagery on Google Maps shows extensive destruction of homes, businesses, and places of worship across Gaza following the three-year war, The Guardian reported. The images reveal the scale of devastation that persists even after a fragile ceasefire took effect.

The satellite data documents ongoing damage to civilian infrastructure throughout the territory, measuring the humanitarian toll of the conflict.

title: Google Maps satellite imagery documents Gaza's mass destruction
